summary.text: Thedis Crowe is a Democratic state representative from Montana who has represented House District 15 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She grew up on the Blackfeet Reservation, worked for federal agriculture and Indian affairs agencies, and serves on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Thedis Crowe was born in Browning, Montana, and grew up on the Blackfeet Reservation.

She earned a bachelor's degree in land resource sciences from Montana State University in 1991 and a graduate degree in Native American studies, with a minor in management and public administration, from the same university in 2003.

Her career experience includes 19 years with the USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service and 14 years with the Bureau of Indian Affairs, and she has been involved with a family ranching operation near Heart Butte.
Crowe won the Democratic primary for House District 15 on June 4, 2024, and defeated Republican Ralph Foster in the November 5, 2024 general election.
She assumed office on January 6, 2025, and was assigned to the Appropriations Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
She defeated Adrien Owen Wagner in the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
